item.description:
​​⚡Monthly Perp DEX Volume Climbs 6% in October

Spot and CEX futures both fell in October, while perpetual DEX volume climbed 6% to $659B.

The drop in centralised-exchange activity lined up with a fall in Bitcoin following a reported $6.3B Binance hack.

Among perp DEXs, the month’s standout was Variational, which climbed to $78B to rank second for the first time, overtaking every challenger behind Hyperliquid.

item.description:
​​🛡️Gate Introduces Proof of Security (PoSEC)

Gate rolled out PoSEC — a framework showing whether an exchange’s cold storage alone could cover all user funds if its hot wallets were lost.

The metric: Cold Storage ÷ User Assets. Gate’s current coverage: 104.58%.

Following its Proof of Reserves push, Gate is positioning PoSEC as a new transparency standard for exchanges.
